paraphrase: I will not treat you as a potter treats raw damp clay; repeatedly restraining you I shall speak, repeatedly admonishing you; the sound core will stand the test.

paraphrase: A monk who delights in company cannot enter the liberation of mind; the Buddha dwells in emptiness internally by not attending to any signs; to do so one steadies the mind internally in the four jhānas and attends to emptiness internally, externally, and to imperturbability, and when walking, standing or speaking stays aware.
